verdict.rationale: Daily is a real-time video and voice API platform that also hosts Pipecat voice AI agents, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back deployed automations is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack documents no versioning, review, or rollback of automations, agents, or configurations. Server-side REST control, webhooks, and auto-recording token properties are adjacent automation features and say nothing about version history or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
